faq_heading: Homes near Forsyth Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Forsyth Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Forsyth Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Forsyth Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Forsyth Road Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 136 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,182,500, townhomes $576,000, condos $410,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Forsyth Road Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Forsyth Road Elementary the median was 30 days on the market, closing at 95.8% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 136 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Forsyth Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Our Lady of Good Counsel (0.5 km south), Honour Secondary School (0.7 km south-west) and Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.0 km east).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Forsyth Road Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Forsyth Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Forsyth Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Forsyth Road Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 136 homes sold within 1 km of Forsyth Road Elementary: 12 houses, 6 townhomes and 118 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $410,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Forsyth Road Elementary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Forsyth Road Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 6 secondary; 3 independent). The closest is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is SD 36 Alternate North Surrey LC, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Honour Secondary School (0.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Kwantlen Park Secondary (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Our Lady of Good Counsel (0.5 km south), Mary Jane Shannon Elementary (1.0 km east), James Ardiel Elementary (1.0 km north), Surrey Traditional (1.1 km north), Ellendale Elementary (1.4 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 0.5 km south of Forsyth Road Elementary.
